name: Cohere
tagline: Enterprise-grade large language models and embeddings via API
description: Cohere provides a REST API for text generation, chat, embeddings, reranking, and classification using its Command and Embed model families. Developers authenticate with an API key and call production endpoints for RAG, semantic search, and generative applications.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header (or X-Api-Key), self-serve from dashboard

pricing.free_tier_limits: Trial key: 1000 API calls/month. Production free tier rate limits vary by endpoint (e.g. Chat 500 RPM / 2M TPM).

rate_limits: Published by key type (Trial vs Production) and endpoint: Chat ~500 RPM / 2M TPM production; Embed ~500 RPM / 2000 TPM; Rerank ~1000 RPM. See docs.cohere.com/docs/rate-limits.

use_cases: generate chat completions with Command models
create text embeddings for semantic search
